procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (53 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side 1-55 in order, no repeats or gaps; q31 holds two match tables. Answer side 1-30, unnumbered match block (two tables), 32-54; q055 no key. Difficulty per question: easy 44, average 5, difficult 6, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 86 (heading) 87 (LO, 9 bullets) 88-91; A pdf 182-186.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-20; s3 T/F q21-30; s4 '31. Match the following appropriately Set and (easy)' q31 (two tables, 16 pairs); s5 one mark q32-41 vsa; s6 two marks q42-47 sa; s7 three marks q48-50 sa; s8 four marks q51-55 la.
q31 table 1 column-A header prints in Kannada; dropped per ruling (rev 2), header given as 'A' — no flag.
q54 tag '(ordinary)' mapped to average (inherited class-9 Ordinary -> average word map); as printed kept in difficulty_as_printed.
q44 tag printed without '(' ('?Average)') — untidy-tag rule. q47 prints a statement ('A foul is a violation of rules.') as a two-mark item; key 'Yes, a foul means …' kept.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_21.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
